free_tier.stated: 5 GB for general materials science research data, 50 GB for AiiDA databases.

per_object_cap.stated: 5 GB for general materials science research data

retention.stated: Items will be retained for the lifetime of the repository, but at least for 10 years after deposition (guaranteed by CSCS).

egress.terms: Access to metadata and data files is provided over standard protocols such as HTTP and OAI-PMH.

tooling: Email self-registration with a personal work area; HTTP + OAI-PMH read; DOI minting per record; versioning of published records. AiiDA provenance integration is the native client for the 50 GB tier.
chaining: Unlimited records x 5 GB (or 50 GB for AiiDA databases). 100 records at 5 GB = 500 GB; the 50 GB AiiDA tier halves that to 10 records.

limits.value: reviewed by the Materials Cloud moderators
5 GB for general materials science research data

limits_note: Per-object-cap 5 GB / 50 GB per record; moderation gate ('Once you submit your record for publication it will be reviewed by the Materials Cloud moderators'), scope-gated to computational materials science, and moderators explicitly police 'excessive submission rate'.
reliability_note: EPFL-hosted and stable, but moderation is substantive (refereeable-quality requirement) and rate-policed. The opposite of an anonymous dump. Data survives; throughput is editorially throttled.
